My plot is small, only a small piece behind the house, and the rains here in the north come only once. I keep some manure from my goats and the few cattle my brother shares with me, and I will spread that on the plot before the rains come — manure I do not pay cash for. Fertilizer from the agro-dealer is too dear for me this year, and one bag is too much for my small plot anyway; I will use what little I saved from last harvest to buy my own seed from the market like my father did. I do all the work myself with my wife and the older children, so I do not need to call anyone to help me.
